note: The Step-to-Move specialization verdict record, machine-readable
(SPEC-draft-pipeline §4.12 is the prose half; kogaki#747, owner rulings
2026-09-01). src/compose.mjs READS these lists rather than restating
them, and checks/check-brief-compose.sh reads them too — this file is
the single carrier, so amending the vocabulary is one edit and never a
three-copy divergence. Same arrangement as src/record-schema.json and
src/gate-schema.json, deliberately.
WHAT THE HARNESS DOES WITH THIS FILE, stated here because the
distinction is the whole design: it VALIDATES a record against these
lists and it NEVER COMPOSES one. No default verdict exists, no verdict
is inferred from a Step's fields, and a missing record is a refusal
rather than a blank to fill. The judgment is the composing sitting's;
the mechanism owns only the record's shape and the refusal.

candidate_id.rationale: a record composed against one Candidate cannot certify another — without this key a sitting could judge the Candidate it liked and adopt the one it wanted

verdict.one_per_step_rationale: a missing verdict and an extra verdict are both refusals, because a per-Step obligation that tolerates a short list is skippable one Step at a time

note: THE OWNER RATIFICATION GATE (kogaki#893, owner selection 2026-09-05).
Everything above governs the record's SHAPE and the refusal. None of
it reaches the one thing that actually unlocks the write: a record
whose every verdict reads `consistent`. That verdict is the composing
sitting's, and until this block existed it was the ONLY thing between
the Harness and the Brief — a record of shape-valid `consistent`
verdicts with no judgment behind them adopted a Candidate with no
refusal, which is the right act with the guard silently disabled.
So a passing record is NOT the sole unlock: adoption additionally
requires an owner ratification recorded at a declared gate. The
refusing arms are untouched — a `contradicts` or `cannot-determine`
record still refuses first, in path order, with the same message, and
is never carried to an owner to ratify. Ratification is asked about a
record that already passes and about nothing else.
WHY A GATE AND NOT A CHECK. The declined arm anchored each `why` in
the Move's requires/effect by string match. It owed a §4.6/§7.5
amendment — `loadMoveIds` reads the library as ids and nothing else,
precisely so nothing is one edit away from comparing requires/effect,
and §7.5 holds that matching judgment-class and never type-checked.
This arm owes no such amendment: §7.5 already surfaces requires/effect
as GATE EVIDENCE, and §4.6 clause 2 already sites the human gate at
approving results. The arm the spec as written already licenses.
THE BINDING IS TWO-AXIS, matching the record's own. A capture
certifies THIS Candidate and THIS record: without the first an owner
ratifies one Candidate and a sitting adopts another, and without the
second the record is editable after ratification and adopts under a
capture that judged different verdicts. The digest is over the
verdicts as judged, so any edit to any verdict invalidates it.

digest.over: the canonical JSON [version, candidate_id, [[step_id, move, verdict, why], ...]] with verdicts in the ADOPTED PATH's order
digest.rationale: path order rather than record order, so a record whose verdicts are merely reordered digests identically and a record whose judgment changed does not

why_three_and_not_two: `cannot-determine` is a first-class value and not an escape hatch: a
two-valued read forces an honest non-answer to render as one of the
two answers, and the value that absorbs it is the passing one.
The served position is the same finding one domain over — a
two-valued exists→accepted read where the ratified rule is
three-valued and the honest value was cannot-determine
It does not weaken the gate: `passing` holds one member, so a
`cannot-determine` refuses exactly as `contradicts` does. What it buys
is that the refusal says WHICH — an unjudgeable Move contract and a
contradicted one need different repairs, and a two-valued record

refusal.rationale: the record's `why` is the one sentence the composing sitting wrote about that Step, so the refusal hands it back rather than paraphrasing it
